sonnet.problem: The answer to this fill-in-the-blank, "iniquity", was already shown on story card 15, which says He was "crushed for our iniquities". A baker can pick the word they just read, so the card gives its own answer away. The blank also asks for the exact word in a line, which the poetry and prophecy rules say not to do.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. Once a choice has been answered, the cards after it can build on that answer. ... An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
